meta.source: design-decisions.md (Language teachers app project), decisions of 2026-10-07 and 2026-10-08; palette 1a 'Warm indigo + cream', warning = amber. Dark warning shades tuned 2026-10-08. Version 2 (2026-10-20): shared rules from the Anki generator redesign (canvas artboard D1) – radius 8, control-lg 44, dialog widths, heading-3, selected state. Version 2.1 (2026-10-21): inline-h and text-line sizes, radius-xs, student-score type style. Version 2.1.1 (2026-10-21): radius-xs 2px, measured against the native 18px checkbox. Version 2.2 (2026-10-22): picking words from pictures (Chip, WordToken, ImageHotspot, ImageViewer, Disclosure, linked state); no token values changed, usage notes of focus and control-md extended. Version 2.3 (2026-10-23): field error – `danger` text at `label` weight under the field; no token values changed.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background (cream / warm near-black).

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, inputs, header, menus.

tokens.name: neutral-soft
tokens.usage: Quiet fills: explanations, progress track, not-answered items.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body text and headings on surface and raised.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, meta lines, labels. 4.5:1 on surface and raised in both themes.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Dividers and card outlines (decorative, not a control boundary).

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Border of everything you click or type in: inputs, secondary buttons, segmented controls, the "not set up" status pill (3:1 control boundary in both themes).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Warm indigo. ONLY the primary action fill, and the text and 2px ring of a selected option, tab or nav item (on accent-soft). Never a fill for a selected state.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover/pressed state of accent fills.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent fills (7.0:1 light, 7.5:1 dark).

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Selected option, tab and nav item (with accent text and a 2px accent ring), selected rows, filter chips, menu highlight, gap highlight in the editor.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Correct answers, "All changes saved". Never decorative.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Background of correct-answer boxes.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning TEXT and field borders. Light: dark amber #7A4A00 (6.5:1 on cream). Dark: light amber #F5C76A (10.1:1 on raised). Never as a fill.

tokens.name: warning-fill
tokens.usage: Amber, same in both themes: borders of warning messages, the 'Unsaved changes' dot, 'Preview' chips (with on-warning text). Not for text.

tokens.name: warning-icon
tokens.usage: The alert-triangle in warning messages (3.2:1 light, 7.9:1 dark on warning-soft). Always next to text.

tokens.name: on-warning
tokens.usage: Text on a warning-fill chip (7.7:1 light, 8.2:1 dark).

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Background of every warning message (box, header flag, inline chip with text).

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: AI notes and neutral hints. Always with an icon + label.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Background of AI-note boxes.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: ONE red for errors AND destructive actions (Delete). Error message = danger-soft + 1px danger border + alert-circle; field error under a field = alert-circle + text in danger at label weight (4.7:1 or more in both themes); delete = trash icon + label, placed last.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Background of error messages and wrong-answer boxes. Message text on it uses `text`; `danger` only for icon and 1px border.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on a filled Delete button (dark text in dark theme: white fails on #FF453A).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring, 3px solid + 2px offset. Inline elements keep >= 5px clear space around the ring (see README). Never orange. Also the 2px linked-state outline (one item shown twice, see Actions and state).

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: PLACEHOLDER until the app name and logo exist. Logo, illustrations, empty states, student results only – never controls, badges or text. Will change; warning is no longer checked against it.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text or glyph on a brand fill (logo letter).

styles.name: heading-3
styles.usage: Section titles inside a panel, tabs.

styles.name: item

styles.usage: Exercise sentences in the editor sheet.

styles.name: body

styles.usage: Meta lines. Smallest size in the app.

styles.usage: Sentences with gaps; tall line for 40px gap boxes.

tokens.name: radius-pill

tokens.name: shadow-sm

tokens.name: shadow-md

size.note: Control heights, dialog widths and icon sizes.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: The main action of a panel on desktop teacher screens (Generate cards, Generate set), and text fields.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default buttons on desktop teacher screens: dialogs, toolbars, status pills, chips.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons inside rows and lists, menu rows, icon buttons in panels. Nothing clickable is smaller.

tokens.name: touch-min

tokens.name: touch-student

tokens.name: icon-md

tokens.name: icon-lg

tokens.name: dialog-sm

tokens.name: dialog-md
tokens.usage: Dialogs with a form or a list.

tokens.name: dialog-lg
tokens.usage: Pickers with two panes (choose students, choose sets).

tokens.name: inline-h
tokens.usage: Height of every inline element in teacher exercise text: gap, marked mistake, word picker, gap chip, context mark.

tokens.name: text-line
tokens.usage: Line height of exercise text in the teacher editor, so inline elements and their focus rings do not touch.
